title: refactor(types,fields,app-shell): field metadata stops declaring host-written and field-level regex keys; geolocation leaves the union (objectui#12242)
body:
Part of #12242
Clause-②: yes

Round two of the field metadata family close-out. It executes maintainer ruling A on the card (comment 6135661503: Q1 A, Q2 A, Q3 B), from `main` `74964ad6`. The authoring face of a field now describes only what a published object can carry. One position is **held, not executed**: `dueLike`, because the ruling's fork clause fired on it (see "The fork" below). That is why the first line is `Part of`, not `Fixes`: the card stays open for that one position.

## What changed

- **`@object-ui/types`** (`field-types.ts`, `form.ts`):
  - **Q1, moved off the authoring face.** `BaseFieldMetadata.mobile_fullscreen`, `LookupFieldMetadata.idField`, and `UserFieldMetadata.picker` / `subtitle` are no longer declared. Each spot carries a "there is deliberately no X here" note that names where the key lives now.
  - `FormField` keeps `idField` / `picker` / `subtitle` at the same types. They were declared by reference to the removed members; the entry now declares them itself (`string`, `'search' | 'default'`, `string[]`). The ruling keeps the faces that already typed them.
  - **Q2, `never` tombstones.** `TextFieldMetadata.pattern` and `pattern_message`, and `BaseFieldMetadata.validate`, are now `never` tombstones. Each docblock names the spec's object-level `format` validation rule, `{ type: 'format', name, field, regex, message }`. `FieldValidationFunction` and `FieldConstraints` are marked `@deprecated` because no member declares them now, the same treatment round one gave `VisibilityCondition`.
  - **Q3, out of the union.** `GeolocationFieldMetadata` leaves `FieldMetadata`. The interface stays exported, marked `@deprecated`, and the `field:geolocation` widget registration is untouched.
  - `FieldValidationRules.pattern`'s docblock no longer says `buildValidationRules` compiles a string pattern.
- **`@object-ui/fields`**:
  - `buildValidationRules` no longer reads `pattern` / `pattern_message` / `validate`. A `location` field's rule is now the stored-value check alone. No client pre-check of the object-level rule is added (the ruling did not take B).
  - New package-local hand-off: `LongTextCarrierHandoff` (`widgets/longTextCarrierHandoff.ts`, not exported from the index, following the `renderHandoff.ts` / `chartRenderHandoff.ts` pattern). `TextAreaField` and `RichTextField` read `mobile_fullscreen` through it, intersected into their existing declared casts. Its producer is still `ObjectForm`, unchanged.
  - `LookupField` reads `idField` / `picker` / `subtitle` through an annotated alias, typed as `Pick` of `FormField` over those three keys. `FormField` is the existing face that declares them. The reads were untyped (`any`) before; behaviour is unchanged.
- **`@object-ui/app-shell`**, `FlowReferenceField` (the flow designer's record-lookup cell). It builds `LookupField`'s carrier with `idField` and the people-picker keys, taken from its own package-local `RecordLookupBinding`. The literal was typed as `LookupFieldMetadata` through the widget prop, so removing `idField` turned `app-shell` `type-check` red (TS2353). The literal is now typed as `LookupFieldMetadata` intersected with `Pick` of `FormField` over the three keys. This is the producer side of the hand-off, fixed on the producer.
- **`@object-ui/plugin-grid`** (`relationalMetaKeys.ts`): the `widget-contract` verdict's docblock and the `idField` row's note now name `FormField` instead of `LookupFieldMetadata`. This is internal data, not exported, with no behaviour change. The derivation test's alias control now expects `LookupField`'s second alias (`pickerConfig`).
- **Docs**:
  - `text.mdx` teaches the object-level `format` rule, written as a prose list (see Acceptance notes).
  - `lookup.mdx` and `user.mdx` drop the moved keys from their field metadata snippets and say where `idField` / `picker` / `subtitle` live now. `user.mdx` shows them on a typed `FormField`.
  - `blocks/forms.mdx`, `plugins/plugin-form.mdx` and the plugin-form README no longer say a field-level string pattern is compiled.

## The fork: `dueLike` is held

The ruling's premise for Q1 is that the spec refuses each key and no published object can carry it. For `dueLike` that is no longer true on `@objectstack/spec`'s own `main`:

- objectstack-ai/objectstack#22503 (merged 2026-10-09, commit `215e66204`, pending changeset `22227-field-deadline-due-like.md`) declares `dueLike` and `settledWhen` on `FieldSchema`, for `date` / `datetime` only. Its changeset names objectui's date cells as the reader.
- The spec installed here (17.7.0) still refuses `dueLike` (`unrecognized_keys`), so the adoption arrives with the next spec release.
- Three example apps in objectstack write `dueLike: true` on published object definitions: `app-crm`'s `activity`, `app-showcase`'s `task` and `app-todo`'s `task`.
- Its readers take it off the object's field definition: `resolveDueLike` in `@object-ui/fields`, which the date and datetime cells call, and the record-detail enrichment copy. That is an authored key, which a runtime hand-off type cannot honestly carry.

So `dueLike` is a reader no hand-off type can carry, and the key is moving toward the authoring face, not away from it. Per the fork clause, this run reports it and does not decide it. `DateFieldMetadata.dueLike`, `DateTimeFieldMetadata.dueLike`, `date.mdx`, `datetime.mdx`, `DetailViewFieldSchema.dueLike` and `schema-reference.md` are all unchanged. No silent C.

## Census of the kept rows (starting from PR objectui#12257's table)

| Interface | Member / value | Installed `FieldSchema` (17.7.0) | Spec `main` | Non-test readers and producers | This PR |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Base | `mobile_fullscreen` | `unrecognized_keys` | not declared | produced by `ObjectForm`; read by `TextAreaField`, `RichTextField`, and the form renderer's built-in `textarea` branch (through its own props type) | moved to `LongTextCarrierHandoff` |
| Base | `validate` | `unrecognized_keys` | not declared | `buildValidationRules` | `never`; read removed |
| Text | `pattern`, `pattern_message` | `unrecognized_keys` | object-level `format` rule only | `buildValidationRules` | `never`; reads removed |
| Date, DateTime | `dueLike` | `unrecognized_keys` | **declared** (objectstack#22503) | `resolveDueLike` (date and datetime cells), `DetailViewFieldSchema.dueLike`, the detail enrichment copy | **held** (fork) |
| Lookup | `idField` | `unrecognized_keys` | not on `FieldSchema` (only on `InlineGridColumnSchema`) | `LookupField`; produced by `FormField` entries, action parameters, `FlowReferenceField` and `GridField` inline columns | moved; `FormField` declares it |
| User | `picker`, `subtitle` | `unrecognized_keys` | not declared | `LookupField`, and `UserField` (defaults); produced by `FormField` entries and `FlowReferenceField` | moved; `FormField` declares them |
| Geolocation | type `geolocation` | `invalid_value` at `type` | not a `FieldType` | the `field:geolocation` widget | out of the union |

`field-metadata-family-retired-12242.test.ts` re-derives the installed-spec column on every run, each row behind an accepting control. The other columns are a reading taken once.

### Fork-clause measurements

- **`type: 'geolocation'` producers.** The query was the regex `type['"]?\s*:\s*['"]geolocation['"]`, excluding tests, specs, `content/**`, `docs/**`, markdown and changelogs:
  - objectui `74964ad6`: 1 hit, `GeolocationFieldMetadata`'s own `type` member. The control, the same query for `text`: 221 files.
  - objectstack `origin/main` `c9b5b24b0`: 0 hits; control: 80 files.
  - hotcrm `0f84c9c`: 0 hits; control: 16 files.
- **Writers of the other Q1 keys** in objectstack (`packages/**`, `examples/**`, `apps/**`) and hotcrm. Every hit was read:
  - `mobile_fullscreen`: 0 in both.
  - `picker` / `subtitle`: none on a field definition. The hits are related-list `add.picker`, page-header `subtitle` and chart `subtitle`.
  - `idField`: only `InlineGridColumnSchema` and unrelated identifiers.
  - `dueLike`: the fork above.

## Export closure (Clause-②)

Measured on the built `.d.ts`: base `74964ad6` from a scratch worktree, head from this branch. The comparison is per top-level declaration, as a token multiset with comments excluded, so the type printer's union-member order cannot read as a change. `@deprecated` is compared separately.

- **Export names:** identical for every `exports` entry of `@object-ui/types`, `@object-ui/fields` and `@object-ui/plugin-grid`. No name is added or removed.
- **`@object-ui/types` declarations changed:**
  - `BaseFieldMetadata`, `TextFieldMetadata`, `LookupFieldMetadata` and `UserFieldMetadata` (the members above).
  - `FieldMetadata` (one union member fewer).
  - `FormField`: the same three member types, now spelled out. `form-field-channel-keys-12130.test.ts` pins them `Equal` to `string` / `'search' | 'default'` / `string[]`, each with `undefined`.
  - `@deprecated` added on `FieldValidationFunction`, `FieldConstraints` and `GeolocationFieldMetadata`.
- **`@object-ui/fields`:** one added file, `widgets/longTextCarrierHandoff.d.ts`. No emitted declaration file references it, and no export entry reaches it. Every other declaration is unchanged.
- **`@object-ui/plugin-grid`:** no declaration changed.

## Tests and gates (at `31da2084`, from the repo root; heavy runs under the shared verify lock)

- `type-check`, with the script name echoed and after the dependency-closure build (turbo, 28 of 28 tasks), exit 0 for each of `@object-ui/types`, `fields`, `core`, `components`, `plugin-form`, `plugin-detail`, `plugin-grid` and `app-shell`. `app-shell` was red once (the `FlowReferenceField` literal above) and green after that fix. `types` was re-run at `31da2084`: exit 0.
- `vitest run`:
  - `packages/types/`, plus the two new `fields` pins: 375 files, 10239 tests passed (at `31da2084`).
  - `packages/fields/`: 252 files passed (1 skipped), 4031 tests passed (at `bf418ddc`; no `fields` source changed after it).
  - A targeted set of 28 files, 354 tests passed (at `bf418ddc`): `plugin-grid` `relationalMetaCopySet.derivation` and `lookupPickerKeys-7154`; the `plugin-form` location suites and `ObjectForm.mobileFullscreen`; `app-shell` `FlowReferenceField*` and `paramToField`; the `components` fullscreen-textarea suites; `schema-catalog` `form-field-channel-census-12130`, `form-field-channel-effects-12130` and `form-builtin-branch-dom-allowlist-12155`; `plugin-detail` `fieldEnrichment`.
  - `scripts/__tests__/` (at `bf418ddc`): 186 files passed, 1 red: `check-doc-component-types`, "this repository is green", on this branch's first `text.mdx`. That page now teaches the rule in prose, and the re-run of that file is green (at `155bd4e1`, with the `types` suite).
- **Gates, each exit 0 at `31da2084`, with its own verdict line:**
  - `check:doc-types`: "Every documented component type is registered".
  - `check:doc-snippets`: "Every covered documentation snippet compiles against the built types" (after the scoped build it names, 37 of 37 tasks).
  - `check:doc-examples`: "Every covered `@example` compiles, or fails exactly as its ledger row declares".
  - `check:doc-json`, `check:doc-fences`, `check:doc-example-ids`, and `check-doc-links` ("Links are valid across 17 scan roots").
  - `check:readme-exports`: OK, 0 fabricated.
  - `check:spec-symbols`, `check:self-import`, `check:phantom-deps`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:handler-key-reads`, `check:esm-specifiers` (specifier leg), and `check:designer-field-key-parity` ("OK").
  - `check:new-line-citations`: "0 new citation(s)". `check:control-bytes`: OK.
  - `check:changeset-claims`: report-only. It names round one's types changeset, whose paragraph about the family pin stays true: this PR adds rows and changes none.
  - `check:pending-changeset-literals`.
  - `check-changeset-presence`: "20 source file(s) of 5 released package(s) changed, and this change declares 2 changeset(s)". Also `check-changeset-no-major` and `check-changeset-fixed`.
  - `check:eager-closure`: 3131.3 KB of 3204.6 KB.
  - `check-governed-queue-guard --test` over the 28 changed paths: NOT GOVERNED.
- **Targeted eslint** on the 19 changed `.ts` / `.tsx` files: 0 errors and 233 warnings. The 16 files that exist at base carry the identical per-file counts there, and the 3 new files carry 0 of each.
  - Population: `eslint.config.js`'s TS block (`**/*.{ts,tsx}`).
  - The count is read from `--format json`.
  - Invariance: the config enables no type-aware linting (no `project` / `projectService`), and no rule in `eslint-rules/` reads another file. So this diff cannot move any untouched file's verdict.

## Ablations (each from committed state, through objectstack's `ablation-replace.mjs`, wrap mode, under the lock)

Each mutation hit its anchor, and the blob changed. Each restore proved blob equal to `HEAD` and an empty `git diff HEAD`.

- **A1**, `pattern?: never` to `string | RegExp`: `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` red, TS2344 on the tombstone assertion and TS2578 (unused `@ts-expect-error`) on `_pattern`.
- **A2**, `idField?: string` put back on `LookupFieldMetadata`: red, TS2578 on `_idField` and TS2344 on the moved-off assertion.
- **A3**, `GeolocationFieldMetadata` put back in the union: red, TS2578 on `_geolocation`.
- **A4**, `buildValidationRules`' field-level `pattern` read put back: 2 rows of the new `fields` pin red ("expected { pattern: … } to be undefined", "expected [ 'maxLength', 'pattern' ] to deeply equal [ 'maxLength' ]").
- **A5**, the field-level `validate` read put back: 1 row red ("expected { validate: [Function validate] } to be undefined"). The `location` control row stayed green, as expected: that branch replaces `rules.validate` wholesale.

The first attempt at A2 to A5 was a no-op: each replacement contained its own anchor, so the tool refused it, and the command never ran. Those readings were discarded and re-run with replacements that consume the anchor.

## Changesets

- `12242-types-kept-positions.md`: `@object-ui/types` minor, BREAKING, FROM → TO for every member and the union. Patch round 1 corrects the pending objectui#12130 changeset's bullet about these keys in place.
- `12242-fields-validation-rules.md`: `@object-ui/fields` minor, BREAKING for hosts that hand-write `pattern` / `validate` in code. Those hosts lose the client-side check; the server enforces the object's `format` rule on save.
- `plugin-grid` (internal note text) and `app-shell` (the same carrier object, now built in a typed const before the render branch) carry no behaviour change and get no release entry; the presence gate counts their files under these two declarations.

## Acceptance notes (observed, not filed)

- `text.mdx` teaches the `format` rule as a prose list, not a code fence. `check:doc-types` reads every fenced `type` value as a node type. Its per-file ledger (where round one exempted `object.mdx`'s `json_schema`) is outside this claim's file surface, and prose is outside that gate's question.
- `ENRICHED_FIELD_METADATA_KEYS` (`plugin-detail`) still copies `idField`, `picker`, `subtitle` and `dueLike` off the served object definition. The installed spec refuses all four on a field, so for spec-compliant data those copies reach nothing. The ruling says behaviour is unchanged, so they stay. Carrier: none.
- No in-repo path emits the form renderer's `validation.pattern` default message any more; `buildValidationRules` was its only producer. `check:i18n-dead-keys` (report-only, exit 0) already listed the pack key as needs-review before this change. Carrier: none.
- `buildValidationRules` still reads `required_message`, `min_length_message`, `max_length_message`, `min_message` and `max_message`, which no type declares. The spec's answer on them was not measured here. Carrier: none.
- `GeolocationFieldMetadata` stays exported, marked `@deprecated`, rather than removed. That follows the `VisibilityCondition` precedent, and the barrel (`index.ts`) is outside this claim's file surface. Removing it would be a separate decision.
